updates.title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services: Enhanced sAM Account Name Synchronization
updates.summary: Public Preview now available for enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAMAccountName) synchronization with Microsoft Entra Domain Services, allowing the attribute to populate from on-premises values rather than relying on mailNickname generation. This improves compatibility with legacy applications and hybrid identity scenarios by maintaining consistent account naming across cloud and on-premises environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: 30-Day Backup and Recovery Capability
updates.summary: Extended backup and recovery for Entra objects is now available, enabling point-in-time restore to a rolling 30-day historical window via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This complements the existing 7-day recovery included with P1 and P2 licenses, giving admins enhanced disaster recovery options for critical identity objects.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online Classification Failures
updates.summary: Public Preview now available for fine-grained DLP policy controls in Exchange Online that respond to specific classification failure types such as timeout and throttling, rather than applying a blanket protection policy. This allows admins to tune protection actions based on the root cause of failures, improving both security posture and user experience.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: DLP alert consolidation by user entity is now generally available, reducing alert noise by merging related events from multiple matched rules into a single alert object. This streamlines investigation workflows and improves contextual understanding of violations for security teams managing high-volume DLP activity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Grouping Modernization
updates.summary: The sensitivity labeling scheme is being simplified to support only labels and modern label groupings, replacing the previous parent-label hierarchy. This modernization improves label usability and configuration, making it easier for admins to organize and categorize labels at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Content Preview in Alerts
updates.summary: Users with appropriate permissions can now preview referenced files directly within Insider Risk Management alerts without creating a case. This capability streamlines the investigation process by providing immediate visibility into potentially risky content within the activity explorer.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: Dynamic scoping for DLP policies on SharePoint is in development, allowing automatic targeting of policies based on site attributes like URL, name, or custom metadata without manual maintenance. This capability eliminates the 100-site static limit and enables scalable, automated policy deployment as SharePoint sites evolve.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will convert complex regulations from PDF documents into actionable controls and improvement actions for multi-cloud environments. Admins can use the AI-generated templates to create assessments, identify gaps, and improve organizational compliance posture more efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI Foundry Integration
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will integrate with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically assess the compliance posture of AI agents and map them to relevant regulations and assessments. This enables organizations to maintain compliance visibility across AI workloads and identify improvement actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Accelerated Policy Sync to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: DLP policy update synchronization time is being reduced from up to 2 hours to 30 minutes, ensuring protections take effect more quickly across the organization. This faster deployment cycle improves the responsiveness of policy changes in enterprise environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: SharePoint File Archiving
updates.summary: SharePoint Online file archiving is being added to Purview Data Lifecycle Management retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive content to low-cost storage as part of their data governance workflow. This enhances compliance capabilities while reducing storage costs and maintaining content discoverability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips for Outlook on Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available in Microsoft Outlook for Mac, notifying users in real-time when email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request policy overrides directly from the mail tip UI, improving user-driven compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Applications
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies are entering preview for protecting sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends Purview's classification engine to multi-cloud environments, enabling unified data protection policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items would be labeled without making changes and review match results and source distribution. This reduces risk of unintended labeling and helps admins validate policy behavior before production deployment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: The Insights tab in sensitivity label policy details now provides at-a-glance performance metrics showing whether a policy is running in simulation or enforcement mode. This helps admins understand labeling effectiveness and make data-driven decisions about policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Applications
updates.summary: Sensitivity label auto-labeling policies are entering preview for non-Microsoft applications including Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine used for Microsoft 365. This enables consistent sensitivity labeling governance across multi-cloud data sources.
